controls.title: Allow only authorised code to execute
controls.statement: Use application control to allow approved software, libraries and scripts and block unapproved code on in-scope systems.
controls.risk: Malicious or unapproved software could run, steal information or disrupt services if systems accept any executable code.
controls.scope: Workstations, servers and operational technology where application control is required and technically feasible.
controls.examine: Compare the approved software inventory with application-control policies, deployment coverage, block events and exceptions.
controls.interview: Ask system and application owners how code becomes authorised and how blocked business software and emergency changes are handled.
controls.test: Attempt to run authorised benign code and a safe unapproved test file, library and script on representative systems.
controls.expected: Authorised code runs, unapproved code is blocked and logged, and policy coverage and exceptions match approved scope.

mappings.basis: Requires technical controls so only authorised software can execute or be accessed, with reassessment at least twice yearly.
Requires deny-all, permit-by-exception software execution and review of the allowed software list.
Calls for application control across IT and OT to prevent unapproved software, scripts, macros and libraries.
Recommends application control on certification authorities as one mitigation for forged-certificate attacks.

controls.title: Govern application-control coverage
controls.statement: Define application-control scope, review allowed code and exceptions, and keep enforcement aligned with system changes.
controls.risk: Application control could provide false confidence if important systems are excluded or old allow rules continue to permit unsafe code.
controls.scope: Application-control policy ownership, system coverage, allow rules, review cycles and exceptions.
controls.examine: Review the approved scope, Essential Eight maturity decision, coverage reports, allowed-code reviews and exception records.
controls.interview: Ask control owners how coverage and maturity targets are set and how system changes trigger policy review.
controls.test: Sample new and changed systems and confirm that enforcement and allowed-code rules were reviewed before use.
controls.expected: The approved scope is implemented, allowed code and exceptions are current, and changes do not create unmonitored gaps.

mappings.basis: Requires the Essential Eight application-control strategy at Maturity Level Two.
Requires implementation of the Essential Eight; application control is one member and its detailed conditions must be assessed separately.
